response.justification: Bogdan brings 13+ years of broad, polyglot engineering experience with genuine depth in testing craftsmanship, high-throughput low-latency services (Sociomantic/Dunnhumby handling millions of requests per second), and a CS degree, which satisfies the baseline technical bar. However, the resume shows essentially no evidence of the role's core domain: experimentation frameworks, feature flagging, telemetry/metrics infrastructure, statistical analysis, or growth measurement. The trajectory is also senior/staff IC at small-to-mid companies rather than principal-level architect driving multi-workstream, cross-org initiatives at enterprise scale, and there is little demonstrated data/metrics aptitude or stakeholder influence at the level described. Worth a conversation only if the team values strong systems fundamentals and is willing to onboard the experimentation domain; otherwise this is a level and domain mismatch.
strengths: 13+ years across many stacks; strong testing/TDD and craftsmanship culture
Real high-scale, low-latency distributed systems work (millions of req/sec)
Open-source founder, conference speaker, and mentor — evidence of influence and teaching
concerns: No experimentation, A/B testing, feature-flagging, or growth-platform experience
Little demonstrated telemetry/metrics infrastructure or statistical analysis depth
Scope reads senior/staff at small companies, not Principal/IC6 enterprise-wide leadership

key_factors.factor: Scope and seniority below Principal/IC6 expectations
Deep, long-tenured engineering breadth with high-scale service experience
